data: What is the BLEU score of the red line at λ = 0.7 in the ZH-EN validate set?

The red line represents +Model II. The ZH-EN validate set is shown on the right graph. At λ = 0.7, the red line is approximately at 23.5. Therefore, the BLEU score of the red line at λ = 0.7 in the ZH-EN validate set is around 23.5.
